title: Tech Note: Simulating a 4D Relationship During Data Entry

historical_commentary.text: Relationship simulation during data entry was a common concern in early 4D development. The Related One relationship behavior described here has evolved significantly through 4D's history, and ORDA's entity-based data model (v17+) provides a fundamentally different approach to managing related data during entry.
related_updates: ORDA (v17+) provides entity-based relationships that handle related data entry differently
The classic Related One/Related Many relationship model has been supplemented by ORDA's dataclass relations
